thread:
Jordan: Quick check-in on the Playground stream UI prototype. Goals: clear stop/regenerate language, token counter behavior on small screens, prompt shelf insert vs replace, and screen-reader streaming announcements. Figma: https://figma.redwood/proto/stream-handshake (frames attached).
Riley: Love the polish. Two concerns: 1) 'Pause' would imply resume; we don't support resume so use 'Stop'. 2) Token pill placement collides with timestamp at narrow widths.
Sam: Agreed on 'Stop'. Tooltip copy suggestion: 'Stop generation (partial content kept)'. Also propose small toast after stop: 'Stream stopped — partial response saved' with 'Regenerate' CTA.
Ava: Token pill behavior: desktop = hover expand; mobile = chevron popover. On touch show per-response tokens plus session total and estimated cost. Make the pill non-verbal by default for screen readers.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: - stream container: aria-live="polite" and role="log" - announce only chunk boundaries, avoid verbose token reads - token popover should be a dialog with role="dialog" and focus trap - controls must have 48px touch targets and visible focus.
Riley: Motion idea: subtle shimmer during stream, fade out when stopped; append small 'partial' badge by token pill. If a user drags a prompt in mid-stream, show confirmation: Replace / Append / Cancel.
Sam: Keybindings: Esc -> stop-stream (add 150ms debounce), Cmd+Enter -> send, Ctrl+Enter -> regenerate. Telemetry: playground.stream.started, playground.stream.stopped_manual, playground.stream.regenerate_clicked. eng-bot: noted, will add to tracking sheet and create feature-flag playground.stream_handshake_v1.
Ava: Prompt shelf insert patterns: drag -> shows preview chip in composer; long-press on mobile -> insert-as-template option. Always show undo snackbar after insert.
a11y-bot: Extra: ensure incremental chunks are announced as short utterances, and avoid announcing token counts unless user opens the popover.
Jordan: Action items: update Figma copy + aria notes, add Esc debounce to spec, finalize popover content for tokens, add telemetry names. Any blockers?
Riley: No design blockers.
Sam: Front-end ready, will coordinate canary with infra.
Ava: I'll run a mobile interaction pass after the first build.
eng-bot: Feature flag and telemetry PRs queued. I'll coordinate a 10% canary roll.
Jordan: Thanks everyone  handoff time.
